policies.title: Remaining European ordinary passports: Bangladesh tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: Bangladesh Police Special Branch's current nationality-based European rule permits tourists holding the 15 listed residual European passports to obtain a physical visa on arrival in Dhaka.
conditions: Ordinary valid passport and short tourist visit only; each listed code is an unambiguous sovereign European state within the current nationality-based rule.
Obtain the single-entry visa at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka for a maximum stay of 30 days; issuance remains subject to the immigration officer's document and compliance review.
Carry a return ticket and at least USD 500 in cash or a credit card, and pay the arrival fee in cash using an accepted currency.
Use the same port for entry and departure; official-ban, work, residence, transit, special-document, Bangladeshi-origin and final-admission rules remain separate.

application.label: Bangladesh Visa on Arrival
steps: Register and submit the current arrival-visa acknowledgement workflow before departure.
Carry the approval or acknowledgement, passport, return ticket, funds and supporting documents to the arrival desk in Dhaka.
Pay the fee and receive the physical visa stamp after the immigration officer's review.

conflicts.explanation: Bangladesh Police Special Branch's current nationality-based rule includes tourists who are citizens of European countries, which unambiguously includes Belarus, and places physical visa issuance at arrival.

unresolved.reason: Myanmar's current numbered 100-country ordinary-passport tourist-eVisa schedule excludes South Sudan, disproving the fallback eVisa. The remaining law, embassy and conditional arrival material does not establish one safe replacement visitor route.
